artifact: comparative and other-date rows excluded from the current panel
motivation: The row date differs from the filing period in SUB.

artifact: identifier recovered from a fallback axis for an ID-less filing
motivation: Every current row in that filing lacks the standard identifier axis; the Legal Entity member itself names the investee.

artifact: fair value recovered from a custom NUM tag keyed by identifier
motivation: The SOI money-market row has an identifier but no standard fair-value fact; NUM supplies the omitted value on that same identifier member.

artifact: equity/warrant security class, affiliate category, and unfunded flag
motivation: Security and affiliate terms are filed in the identifier or standard security axes; commitment columns carry unfunded amounts.

artifact: identifier is a total/subtotal or category-only label
motivation: The filed identifier is a total/subtotal or a category-only label rather than an individual investment.

artifact: short issuer summary duplicates a detailed row
motivation: Within one filing, a short identifier with neither cost nor principal contains the same issuer key as a separately filed instrument-detail row.

artifact: cash or money-market line in schedule
motivation: The identifier explicitly names cash or a money-market fund, so it is a liquidity line rather than an investment holding.
